items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Stock Still Trades At A Premium On Sales Despite Weaker Earnings
items.summary: Tesla stock has fallen 29.8% year to date, yet the valuation checks still point to a company that screens as expensive rather than obviously cheap on current fundamentals. The share price decline of 29.8% so far this year has reset expectations for Tesla, but not enough to flip the stock into clear bargain territory on standard valuation metrics.
